empty_intro: Use the same network or add a console manually.
searching: Looking on your network. You can also add an IP address.
search_off: Use the same network and enable discovery, or add a console manually.
tagline: Your screen. Your console. Your time to play.
support_body: Deckivo is free and open source. Your support helps fund signing, new platforms and real-device testing.
support_status: Everything stays free. Supporting is optional.
contribute_body: Test a release, improve a translation or contribute code. No account is needed to use Deckivo.
site_lead: Your PlayStation, on the device beside you. Meet a new space for Remote Play.
feature1body: Find your console, see its state and start a session from one clear screen.
feature2body: Check your buttons and sticks. Keep PS and touchpad controls out of the way until you need them.
feature3body: Choose your language and stream settings. Keep your registrations when you update.
platforms_body: Android comes first. Windows, macOS and Linux are next on the development roadmap.
roadmap1: Android · redesign, languages and device testing
roadmap2: 1.0.0 · owner acceptance, then public source and website
roadmap3: Desktop · Windows, macOS and Linux builds and testing
community_body: Built on the work of Chiaki, chiaki-ng and Android Extended. Deckivo adds a new interface and its own improvements, with upstream credits and source preserved.
support_note: Everything stays free. Supporting is optional.
no_telemetry: No advertising or analytics SDK in this build.
attribution_short: Independent project. Not affiliated with Sony or Nintendo.
local_test: Local play tested on Switch OLED.
wan_note: Internet play is a separate stage; it is not yet validated.
